sentences.zh: “匿名者Q”的核心是一个极度依赖日期的信仰体系。

sentences.en: So, just to recap Cliff Notes' version, QAnon is this big, sprawling conspiracy theory about this global cabal of satanic pedophiles who run the world.
sentences.zh: 所以，简而言之，“匿名者Q”是一个庞大而杂乱的阴谋论，关于一个统治世界的撒旦恋童癖全球秘社。

sentences.en: No basis, in fact.

sentences.en: It's totally made up.

sentences.en: Basically, unspooling this theory about how Donald Trump was secretly working to take down this cabal and that there would be this day in the future, this moment of reckoning

sentences.en: And Kevin, does anyone know, I don't know if this is measurable, how many people believe in this clearly false conspiracy of Q and his prophecies?

sentences.zh: 他们在看我在脸书上发的东西，如你所知，我发了很多。

sentences.en: And then my sister said, you know, I'm worried about you.
sentences.zh: 然后我姐姐就说，你知道的，我很为你担心。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, that's it.
sentences.zh: 而我的反应是，哦，就这样啊。

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: If that's all you got out of what I'm posting is your concern for me, then there's no conversation.
sentences.zh: 如果从我发的内容里你只读出了对我担心的情绪，那我们没什么好聊的。

sentences.en: Because what I'm doing, I feel really great about it.
sentences.zh: 因为对于我正在做的事，我感觉真的很好。

sentences.en: I feel really great about my online community.
sentences.zh: 我对我的在线社群感觉真的很好。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: And if I asked your sister, like in general, what she, what she thinks of your relationship, what do you think she would say?
sentences.zh: 如果我问你姐姐，比如总的来说，她，她对你们的关系怎么看，你觉得她会怎么说？

sentences.en: She's very hurt.
sentences.zh: 她非常受伤。

sentences.en: She's very hurt by the fact that I pull back.
sentences.zh: 因为我选择疏远，她感到非常受伤。

sentences.en: Would it be okay if I tried to contact your sister?
sentences.zh: 如果我试着联系你姐姐，可以吗？

sentences.en: I would really rather not.
sentences.zh: 我真的宁愿不要这样。

sentences.en: And it's, it's, it's an awkward relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且，这，这，这是一种尴尬的关系。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And, um.
sentences.zh: 还有，嗯。

sentences.en: So are there other people that I might call and just say, what's your relationship with Valerie like?
sentences.zh: 那还有没有什么其他人我可以打电话问问，比如你和瓦莱丽的关系怎么样？

sentences.en: And, and anyone that you have known for a while?
sentences.zh: 而且，而且有没有什么你认识有一段时间的人？

sentences.en: Well, I don't, I am not talking to anyone right now.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有，我现在谁也不联系。

sentences.en: And that is my choice.
sentences.zh: 这是我自己的选择。

sentences.en: So when I, you know, if there was someone that I felt, there's no one that comes to mind.
sentences.zh: 所以当我有，你知道的，如果真有我觉得可以联系的人，脑海里也空无一人。

sentences.en: And when I, you know, so, no.
sentences.zh: 所以当我，你知道的，所以，没有。

sentences.en: So she'd cut off ties with her friends.
sentences.zh: 所以她切断了与朋友的联系。

sentences.en: She'd been estranged from family members.
sentences.zh: 她与家庭成员疏远了。

sentences.en: Like QAnon had really become not just a thing that she believed.
sentences.zh: 比如QAnon真的不只是她所相信的一个东西。

sentences.en: It had become her entire social life.
sentences.zh: 它已经成了她整个的社交生活。

sentences.en: I felt, um, you know, in terms of finding myself alone right now and, and wanting it that way, it's, um, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，嗯，你知道的，就目前发现自己孤身一人而言，而且，而且我本来就想要这样，这，嗯，这没关系。

sentences.en: It's all okay.
sentences.zh: 这一切都没关系。

sentences.en: And like I say, if, if friends who are different from me didn't patronize me or scream at me and say, I'm worried about you, that is the most fucking patronizing thing you can say.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，如果，如果那些与我不同、却不对我居高临下或对我大喊大叫、还说“我很为你担心”的朋友，那真的是你所能说出的最他妈居高临下的话了。

sentences.en: Well, isn't, isn't somebody worrying about you?
sentences.zh: 好吧，难道，难道不是有人在为你担心吗？

sentences.en: Isn't that loving?
sentences.zh: 难道这不是充满爱意的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, that doesn't sound painful to me.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来对我来说并不痛苦。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: Not when I, and not when I then tell her, I have never felt better in my life.
sentences.zh: 当我，而且当我随后告诉她我一生中从未感觉这么好时，就不是这样了。

sentences.en: Not when I'm actually happy.
sentences.zh: 当我真正感到快乐时，就不是这样了。

sentences.en: If I was complaining, that's one thing.
sentences.zh: 如果我在抱怨，那是另一回事。

sentences.en: No, I think that's horrible.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得那太糟糕了。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的是这么觉得的。

sentences.en: I'm worried about you.
sentences.zh: 我很为你担心。

sentences.en: That is patronizing.
sentences.zh: 那太居高临下了。

sentences.en: You know, what if I said that to you?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我对你这么说呢？

sentences.en: I'm worried about you.
sentences.zh: 我很为你担心。

sentences.en: You work for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 你为《纽约时报》工作。

sentences.en: That's none of my business.
sentences.zh: 这不管我的事。

sentences.en: You like it.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢它。

sentences.en: It's your job.
sentences.zh: 这是你的工作。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm guessing, I don't know, but you know what I'm saying?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我猜的，我不知道，但你懂我的意思吗？

sentences.en: We are in different worlds.
sentences.zh: 我们处在不同的世界里。

sentences.en: And so what happens to people like Valerie?
sentences.zh: 那么像瓦莱丽这样的人会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Where do they go from here?
sentences.zh: 从这里开始他们要走向何方？

sentences.en: It's a really vulnerable, uncertain moment for believers in QAnon.
sentences.zh: 对于QAnon的信徒来说，这是一个非常脆弱、充满不确定性的时刻。

sentences.en: And I think some of them are doing what they always do.
sentences.zh: 我想他们中的一些人正在做他们一直在做的事。

sentences.en: They're pushing the date back.
sentences.zh: 他们在把日期往后推。

sentences.en: They're moving the goalposts.
sentences.zh: 他们在移动终点线。

sentences.en: But a lot of them are just sort of floating.
sentences.zh: 但他们中的很多人只是在随波逐流。

sentences.en: They don't know what or who to believe.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道该相信什么，或者该相信谁。

sentences.en: And there are groups that are preying on that uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 有些组织正在利用这种不确定性进行捕食。

sentences.en: Like, it's important to remember that QAnon has been, in many ways, like, a very destructive and dangerous movement.
sentences.zh: 比如，记住这一点很重要：在许多方面，QAnon一直是一个非常具有破坏性和危险性的运动。

sentences.en: Like, there have been real acts of violence.
sentences.zh: 比如，曾发生过真正的暴力行为。

sentences.en: There was a mob at the Capitol that was driven in some way by QAnon believers.
sentences.zh: 国会山曾出现过一群暴徒，他们在某种程度上是受QAnon信徒驱使的。

sentences.en: And now, some other extremist groups, white supremacist groups, far-right militias,
sentences.zh: 而现在，其他一些极端主义组织、白人至上主义组织、极右翼民兵组织，

sentences.en: have started trying to capitalize on this moment of confusion by recruiting QAnon believers into their movements and attaching them to their causes.
sentences.zh: 已经开始试图通过招募QAnon信徒加入他们的运动、并将他们与自己的事业捆绑来利用这股混乱时刻。

sentences.en: So, Kevin, is Q over in a certain sense?
sentences.zh: 那么，凯文，从某种意义上说，Q已经结束了吗？

sentences.en: Is it on a path that is no longer sustainable, given what just happened?
sentences.zh: 鉴于刚刚发生的事情，它是否正处于一条不再可持续的道路上？

sentences.en: I think the original form of QAnon, this conspiracy theory centered on the posts of this anonymous person on the internet that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为QAnon最初的形式，这种以互联网上这个匿名人士的帖子为中心的阴谋论，你知道的，

sentences.en: was all about Donald Trump defeating the deep state.
sentences.zh: 完全是关于唐纳德·特朗普击败深层政府的。

sentences.en: I think that part may be close to over.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一部分可能已经接近结束了。

sentences.en: But I think what QAnon represents, this kind of alternate reality of conspiracy theories and lies,
sentences.zh: 但我认为QAnon所代表的，这种充满阴谋论和谎言的另类现实，

sentences.en: this sort of group of millions of Americans who don't trust official explanations, who want secret knowledge,
sentences.zh: 这种由数百万不信任官方解释、渴望获得秘密知识的美国人组成的群体，

sentences.en: who are sort of creating their own truth out of fragments of stuff they read and see on the internet.
sentences.zh: 他们从互联网上阅读和看到的碎片中创造出自己的真相。

sentences.en: I think that's not going away anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 我认为这不会很快消失。

sentences.en: Have you talked to Valerie since the inauguration?
sentences.zh: 就职典礼之后你和瓦莱丽谈过吗？

sentences.en: I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 我谈过。

sentences.en: And I asked her, like, how she felt now that her prediction about the inauguration had proven false.
sentences.zh: 我问她，既然她关于就职典礼的预测已被证明是错误的，她现在感觉如何。

sentences.en: You know, I don't have an end date.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我没有截止日期。

sentences.en: The sands keep shifting.
sentences.zh: 情况一直在变。

sentences.en: And in point of fact, Q never promised anything by any date.
sentences.zh: 事实上，Q从来没有在任何日期承诺过任何事情。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's been anticipation, impatience, frustration from the get-go.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，从一开始就一直有期待、不耐烦和沮丧。

sentences.en: But, you know, in all...
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，总的来说……

sentences.en: She's still very much a believer.
sentences.zh: 她依然是个坚定的信徒。

sentences.en: In her mind, the fact that Joe Biden is the president doesn't change anything.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，乔·拜登是总统这一事实并没有改变任何事情。

sentences.en: His presidency will not stand.
sentences.zh: 他的总统任期不会持久。

sentences.en: It's a stolen crown.
sentences.zh: 这是一个偷来的王冠。

sentences.en: And I am still 100% positive that that will be proved.
sentences.zh: 我依然百分之百确信这一点会得到证实。

sentences.en: The faith is really unshakable in the fact that this is not only a political plan and a military one, but a divine one.
sentences.zh: 对于这不仅是一个政治计划和军事计划、更是一个神圣计划这一点，这种信仰真的是不可动摇的。

sentences.en: That there is something...
sentences.zh: 这里有一些……

sentences.en: There is something bigger than all of us going on here.
sentences.zh: 这里正在发生一些比我们所有人都更宏大的事情。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯文。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The South African variant of the coronavirus has been detected in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在美国检测到了新冠病毒的南非变异毒株。

sentences.en: Two cases of the more contagious mutation have been found in South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 在南卡罗来纳州发现了这种传染性更强的变异毒株的两起病例。

sentences.en: Neither involved people who had recently traveled to South Africa, suggesting that the variant has been spreading for some time within the United States.
sentences.zh: 这两人近期都没有去过南非旅行，这表明该变异毒株已经在美国传播了一段时间。

sentences.en: And on Thursday, General Motors said that it would phase out gas and diesel-powered cars and trucks by 2035, a historic change that will pressure rival automakers to do the same.
sentences.zh: 周四，通用汽车表示，将在2035年前逐步淘汰燃油轿车和卡车，这是一项历史性变革，将对竞争对手汽车制造商施加压力，迫使它们效仿。

sentences.en: GM says that it will only sell vehicles that produce zero tailpipe emissions.
sentences.zh: 通用汽车表示，其将仅销售零尾气排放的汽车。

sentences.en: The move will have a major impact on the oil and gas industry, which relies heavily on gas-powered cars.
sentences.zh: 此举将对严重依赖燃油汽车的石油和天然气产业产生重大影响。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.zh: 我不是指他们睡觉时会不会失去意识。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
